svg.aria-label: P3 Dreg per curve and presentation family, n=43
svg.title: P3 Dreg per curve and presentation family, n=43
svg.text: P3 ECC2K-130 analogue, n = 43: Dreg per curve, by presentation family (E0 ringed)

Point = mean over attempts of the per-attempt minimum Dreg over a curve's presentations in that family (recorded `dreg`; hollow triangle = bound, Dreg > dmax). x = curve index, 0 = E0; bands = Frobenius orbits.
Each family drawn at a small vertical offset for legibility (the value is the point's centre line). Grey band in a panel: range of the random-b null curves' mean Dreg, arm `null`, when measured.
random V (main): 259/259 curves | standard V: 10/259 curves | b-adapted: 10/259 curves | b-sparse: 10/259 curves | nbadapt (dense-b control): pending
E0 mean Dreg: main 7.00, stdv 6.00, badapt 6.00, bsparse 6.00
random V (main): 259/259 curves | standard V: 10/259 curves | b-adapted: 10/259 curves | b-sparse: 10/259 curves | nbadapt (dense-b control): pending
E0 mean Dreg: main 8.00, stdv 8.00, badapt 8.00, bsparse 8.00
random V (main): 259/259 curves | standard V: pending | b-adapted: pending | b-sparse: pending | nbadapt (dense-b control): pending
null curves: not measured in this cell

Counted metrics (dreg, outcome) are exact; presentations: stdv = standard V in several moduli, badapt = V = span(1,g,..,g^(k-1)) with g adapted to b (E0 borrows the floor curves' moduli), bsparse/nbadapt as in PROTOCOL section 4.
Source data: p3_dreg_n43.data.tsv (pooled recorded rows of p3_ecc2k130/full). A series with no row in a cell is shown as pending; bounds are never plotted as values.
